versions.author: c_lennox
versions.content:
# The Lennox Hotel Columbus: group sales agreement, draft 1
Group: GLSFE Spring Facilities Summit. Dates: arrive Monday, April 12, 2027; depart Wednesday, April 14, 2027.

1. Rooms: Mon 4/12 60, Tue 4/13 90 (150 room-nights) at $179 single/double, plus applicable taxes. Cutoff Friday,
   March 12, 2027.
2. Attrition: the group agrees to use at least 80% of the rooms contracted on each night. Shortfall on any night
   is billed at the group rate.
3. Food and beverage minimum: $42,000 before the 25% service charge and tax (280 attendees at our two-day
   conference package of $150 per person).
4. Meeting space: Buckeye Ballroom and four breakout rooms, Tue 4/13-Wed 4/14. Rental $6,000, waived if the F&B
   minimum is met.
5. Cancellation by the group, as a percentage of anticipated revenue ($68,850: rooms $26,850 plus the F&B
   minimum): more than 180 days before arrival 25%; 179 to 90 days 50%; 89 days or fewer 100%.
6. Deposit: $5,000 on signing, applied to the master account.
7. Force majeure: either party may terminate without liability if an act of God, war, terrorism, government
   order, disaster or epidemic makes the event illegal or impossible.
8. This offer is held until Friday, November 13, 2026. Signature: the group's authorized signatory.

versions.author: c_owen
versions.content:
FOR RELEASE WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2026
Record 450 facility engineers gather in Detroit for GLSFE Fall Technical Conference

ANN ARBOR, Mich. A record 450 facility and plant engineers from Michigan, Ohio and Indiana will gather Thursday,
November 5 at the Henley Hotel Detroit for the Great Lakes Society of Facility Engineers' Fall Technical
Conference. Dr. Alicia Fernandez of the University of Michigan opens with "Decarbonizing campus energy."
Sessions include Raj Mehta of Thermaline Systems on chiller plant optimization and Kevin Lindqvist of Michigan
Tech on decarbonization roadmaps. Attendees earn professional development hours toward license renewal. Eighteen
exhibitors, led by platinum sponsor Ameridrive Controls, will be on the floor.
"Our members keep Great Lakes buildings and plants running," said Executive Director Gwen Holloway.
Media contact: Owen Pratt, 734-555-0157.
